purpose: Build a date-aware timeline of verified relationships between parties and property interests, showing when roles began, changed or ended and the evidence supporting each transition.
core_principle: PARTY + ROLE + INTEREST + PROPERTY + DATE + EVENT + EVIDENCE
rules: A relationship timeline records supported relationships, not assumptions created by chronological proximity.
Start and end dates remain distinct from document and registration dates.
A relationship may change because of an event, but causation must be independently supported.
A role change does not necessarily mean an ownership change.
A property interest may continue while its holder changes.
A holder may have multiple simultaneous roles and interests.
Historical relationships require evidence appropriate to the target period.
Unresolved identity, property or date matching must remain visible.
hard_stops: Never infer a relationship merely because a party appears before or after an event.
Never merge similar party names without identity evidence.
Never merge properties solely by address.
Never treat a current role as historical without historical evidence.
Never expose private relationship evidence in a public timeline.
